generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a fast-growing tree with a straight stem, a narrow, rounded crown, alternate oval leaves with double-toothed edges, and hanging catkins. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 15 m tall and 22 cm across at breast height at 20 years in the open; 24 m tall and 40 cm across at breast height at 40 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dark green leaves; smooth, pale grey bark, often blotched with lichen. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: small green cones (strobiles) about 2 cm long, three to eight on a short raceme. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: catkins in February; the cones green through the summer, brown from September, hanging on into the next winter. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth thin grey bark, whitened in patches by lichens, with lenticels; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.
